# VexFlow

- Version: 5.0.0
- Source: https://github.com/0xfe/vexflow
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vexflow/v/5.0.0
- License: MIT (`LICENSE`)
- Bundled file: `vexflow-bravura.js`

The bundled browser build includes the Bravura music font data used to engrave
standard notation and guitar tablature without a network dependency.
